hints.title: Daily Active User Window Aggregation
hints.text: Filter events occurring within thirty days ending 2019-07-27, computing distinct active users for each calendar date.

hints.title: Between Date Filtering with Distinct Count
hints.text: Filter records on the activity date between 2019-06-28 and 2019-07-27, then group by date and count distinct user identifiers.

hints.title: User Activity Query Blueprint
hints.text: select activity_date as day, count(distinct user_id) as active_users from Activity where activity_date between "2019-06-28" and "2019-07-27" group by activity_date.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM Activity
WHERE activity_date BETWEEN '2019-06-28' AND '2019-07-27'
GROUP BY activity_date;
```

variables: D: distinct days within the 30-day window
complexity.notes: Filtering on date range and aggregating distinct users per day runs in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to deduplicate user identifiers overcounts multiple interactions from the same user on one day.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouped count distinct computes exact daily metrics with memory bounded by 30 days.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Proper date interval inclusive range and COUNT(DISTINCT user_id).
